scope: Remaining-candidate exploratory screen; existing E1/E3 checkpoints, no new environment or learner updates.
F02: Exact replay cumulative sample counter difference parent->20k, collected task counts, new/old sample fraction, per-task age and expected FIFO exposure from initial ring and observed collection order. No future20k->40k sample values.
F03: Last20 completed500-step training episodes/task, walking verified checkpoint ancestry when branch has fewer20. Official episode success, equal-length return, unique initial-state hashes and experience recency. No high-reward success imputation.
coverage: M/A raw39-D replay moments. Primary exploration feature is successful-experience fraction focus/other; secondary coverage is log1p RMS standardized displacement to PARENT mean, scale sqrt(parent variance) floored0.01. This parent-only reference differs from v23 proposed pooled development-fold scaling, is fixed here before new measurement, and is available at decision time; regression standardization still train-fold only. No neural features, no inference of semantic progress from raw distance.
models: CriticBase=full marginal success controls+F05 scales/residual/gap. F02 adds focus collection-minus-observed sample share and all-task new-data sample fraction. F02_expected replaces observed focus share by exact expected FIFO share. F02_age adds focus/other mean replay age normalized by buffer_size. ExperienceBase adds recent500-step return focus/other and log1p age of oldest included episode focus/other. F03 adds recent success fractions focus/other. F03_coverage adds raw displacement focus/other. F03_both combines four. F03_unique adds unique counts focus/other. All prespecified, no threshold/model tuning.
prediction: Copy frozen held-original-seed ridge protocol: lambda1 weighted mean loss, fold-only standardization, D50/O50 hash split, A/B/C equal and A checkpoints half. Features20k predict same-branch D40-D20. Same-repeat primary and cross-repeat secondary. Historical data exploratory.
screen: Each candidate primary vs its stated baseline: >=1pp, >=2 positive original seeds, no group below-2pp. F02 primary observed exposure, F03 primary success experience. Case-only intervals do not cover training/model/selection uncertainty.
limitations: F02 sampling causal intervention is conditional future stage; F03 experience measurement does not establish exploration mechanism. Phase reach metrics, if collected in v31, remain supplementary. Not G3/G4.
